decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development Order) 1995 (or any order revoking or re-enacting that order) no enlargement of the premises or any additional structures/buildings within the curtilage of the site shall be carried out.

Condition : 5 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification), no windows/dormer windows [other than those expressly authorised by this permission] shall be constructed.
Condition : 6 - The window formed in the east elevation first floor shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 7 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the east flank wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 8 - All hard and soft landscape works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.  The works shall be carried out prior to the occupation of any part of the development or in accordance with the programme agreed with the local planning authority
Condition : 9 - The building shall not be occupied until a means of vehicular access has been constructed in accordance with the approved plans.

Condition : 10 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.

Condition : 11 - Before first occupation of the buildings the loading, unloading and turning space, and parking spaces (including spaces for people with disabilities) shall be provided within the curtilage of the site in accordance with the scheme shown on drawing No. 02006/01a Amended  and such spaces shall be permanently available and not be used for any other purpose.

Condition : 12 - REASON FOR APPROVAL

It is considered that the proposed development because of its position, scale, size, design, character and appearance, would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of no.20 Canterbury Road and would be complementary to the visual amenity of the locality. It would not be detrimental to the amenities of the adjacent neighbouring properties and the street scene.  On balance, the development is considered acceptable and would be in accordance with the Adopted UDP Policies ENV - B.1.1 (New Development), H.4.1 (Housing Standards and Guidelines), H.6.3 (Backland Development/Infill Development), T1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities For Developments), T.5.3 (Vehicle Crossovers and Hardstandings) and the Supplementary Planning Guidance of the London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted (December 2003). It is considered that where the development is not compliant there are no undue adverse effects resulting from this.
description: Erection of a two storey side extension to provide a 2 bedroom house with associated parking and amenity area.
